sentences.l2: 在电商平台上，“立即购买”按钮该用什么颜色，往往不取决于设计师的直觉，而取决于A/B测试。
sentences.l1: On an e-commerce platform, what color the “Buy Now” button should be often does not depend on the designer's intuition, but on A/B testing.

sentences.l2: 所谓A/B测试，就是把访问网站的用户随机分成两组：一组继续看到原来的橙色按钮，称为对照组；另一组看到新设计的绿色按钮，称为实验组。
sentences.l1: So-called A/B testing is randomly dividing the users who visit the website into two groups: one group continues to see the original orange button, called the control group; the other group sees the newly designed green button, called the experimental group.

sentences.l2: 两组的其他条件保持一致，因此任何差异都可归因于颜色本身。
sentences.l1: The other conditions of the two groups are kept the same, so any difference can be attributed to the color itself.

sentences.l2: 实验持续数周后，团队会比较两组的转化率，即点击按钮并最终下单的用户所占的比例。
sentences.l1: After the experiment lasts several weeks, the team compares the conversion rates of the two groups, that is, the proportion of users who click the button and ultimately place an order.

sentences.l2: 然而，数字上的微弱领先并不足以说明问题，因为偶然波动同样可能造成差距。
sentences.l1: However, a slight lead in the numbers is not enough to settle the matter, because chance fluctuation can equally cause a gap.

sentences.l2: 分析人员还要检验结果的显著性，判断差异是否超出了随机误差的范围。
sentences.l1: Analysts must also test the significance of the results, judging whether the difference goes beyond the range of random error.

sentences.l2: 只有达到预设标准，平台才会全面更换颜色。
sentences.l1: Only when the preset standard is reached will the platform change the color across the board.
